children: According to ChainCatcher citing Lookonchain, a whale’s 1.38 million HYPE long position, valued at $81.23 million, faces liquidation risk. Its unrealized profit had previously exceeded $68 million.
To avoid liquidation, the whale deposited another $5 million in USDC into Hyperliquid. The position’s new liquidation price is $54.55.

title: $81.23 Million HYPE Long Faces Liquidation Risk as Whale Adds $5 Million in USDC
